target.title: test(infra): add unit tests for FormData detection helper
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

The `isFormDataLike` function detects FormData objects at the network layer boundary. Without tests, the type guard could silently break.

## Why This Change Was Made

Add unit tests covering null, undefined, plain objects, strings, and objects with Symbol.toStringTag.

## User Impact

FormData detection now has comprehensive test coverage.

## Evidence

Direct behavior probe with real function calls:

```text
$ node --import tsx -e "import('./src/infra/net/form-data.js').then(({isFormDataLike})=>console.log(JSON.stringify([{i:null,r:isFormDataLike(null),e:false},{i:{},r:isFormDataLike({}),e:false},{i:'form-data',r:isFormDataLike('form-data'),e:false}])))"
[{"i":null,"r":false,"e":false},{"i":{},"r":false,"e":false},{"i":"form-data","r":false,"e":false}]
```

Targeted test:

```text
$ node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run src/infra/net/form-data.test.ts
Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  6 passed (6)
```

Formatting: `npx oxfmt --check` passed. Whitespace: `git diff --check` passed.
